text:
jia: photo drop  tiny wildlife corner update - my axolotl, Nimbus, discovered the shallow sun bowl and is now doing this adorable flat "sploot" facing the light. looks like a little gelatinous loaf :sweat_smile: (pic attached)

otto: wait you have an axolotl? that's a level of pet flex i admire. is he ok with the shallow water?

jia: yes! all safe. its just a shallow basking spot under a low-heat lamp for short supervised sessions. water still deep in main tank. safety first.

marc: naming contest: 1) Nimbus the Cloud 2) Gelatinous Gordon 3) Light Loaf. react with 1/2/3 or reply other :sparkles:

jia: currently accepting all puns. also fun fact: axolotls don't actually bask like lizards, he's just vibing with the warm light for 2-3 mins. supervising.

ops-bot: jia added a file: nimbus-sunbask.jpg (650KB)

otto: voting 1. Nimbus is peak mood. also sending an animated clap gif.

marc: pro tip from my friend with a tank: short sessions + cool down are the way. thanks for the safety note!

jia: agreed. i keep a timer and never leave the room while he's out. here's the tiny checklist i follow: 1) lamp on low 2) 2-3 minute max 3) tray water replaced each time 4) monitor gill movement.

otto: this thread is peak wholesome. can we start a monthly "weird pets" photo drop? i vote yes.

jia: count Nimbus in. he sends a slow gill flutter and a tiny blink. :herb:
